leads.title: Lessons of the wilderness; the good land; beware of pride ↔ The clot: recite! and the forelock
leads.summary: 1 correspondence read side by side: 1 same element.

evidence.text: Read side by side in both originals (alignments/hb-quran/08-hb-quran.yaml).
Shared motifs, rarest first: Woe to every slanderer and backbiter (humaza lumaza) who amasses and counts wealth, thinking it makes him immortal (weight 5.6). Pair score 5.6.

Only in Lessons of the wilderness; the good land; beware of pride: Wilderness of fiery serpents and scorpions; When you eat and are satisfied, bless God for the land; Land whose stones are iron and from whose hills copper is dug; Man does not live by bread alone but by every word from God's mouth; God tests the community 'until we know' who strive and are patient; Springs and fruit of the promised land or of the Garden [divergence between the texts]; Given a blessing, man says 'I was given it only because of my knowledge'; it is a trial; The wilderness journey was to humble and test Israel; Clothes did not wear out and feet did not swell for forty years; God disciplines Israel as a man disciplines his son; Warning against saying my power and the might of my hand made this wealth; When you eat and are full, beware lest you forget God; and 6 more.

Only in The clot: recite! and the forelock: Let the opponent call his council (nadi); God will call the guards of hell (al-zabaniya); A man who forbids a servant of God to pray is threatened: he will be dragged by his lying, sinful forelock; God taught humankind by the pen (qalam) what it did not know; Human created in stages: a drop of sperm (nutfa), a clinging clot ('alaq/'alaqa), then shaped and proportioned; Narrative of a prophet's commissioning by God.
